title: Fix Mcp App Scene and Diagram Without Timeout
description:
Keeping GLB blobs inline in the MCP App payload causes a 33MB payload (90 GLBs × 318KB avg = 28.6MB) and MCP timeout. Need to fix GLTF loading via the existing HTTP URL approach instead.

The HTTP URL `/api/app/files/{guid}` IS served, but needs CORS headers so the sandboxed iframe can fetch it. The CSP is already declared via `connectDomains` in `_mcp_app_html_resource_meta`. The HTTP endpoint may be missing `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` header.

Plan:
1. Revert `_strip_kit_blobs` to strip ALL blobs (not just non-GLBs) - restore original behavior
2. Fix CORS on the `/api/app/files/{guid}` endpoint so the iframe can fetch it
3. Fix CORS on the `/api/app/payload/{token}` fetchUrl endpoint
4. Rebuild dist/mcp-app.html (only if JS changes needed)
